title: Tiny House Hotel in East Nashville | Suite K
description:
At Ironwood Grove we have created an unprecedented tiny house hospitality experience nestled in the bustling, eclectic epicenter of East Nashville. Our tiny homes let you explore the curiosity of tiny living while indulging in our special selection of local amenities, our clever and efficient uses of small spaces, and stunning finishes. We hope Ironwood Grove feels like your cozy (tiny) home away from home as you explore the local music, art, and food of the great Music City.

The space
This tiny house brings in all of the natural light with its huge picture windows. The star of this suite is its luxurious bath, complete with a ceiling mounted rain shower in an open, concrete bathroom surrounded by frosted glass. It is stocked with the Good Fill's clean, zero waste soaps, and bath & body products. Sleep cozy in the main bedroom on a queen-sized memory foam bed. You'll have plenty of storage with custom built-in cabinets. The main living space features a kitchenette where you'll have a mini fridge, two burner stove, and microwave. Guests are welcome to enjoy our complimentary beverage bar with our exclusive locally roasted coffee and assortment of teas. Max occupancy: 2 adults.

Other things to note
Please note that there is a train crossing nearby, so you may hear a train horn during your stay. We have provided earplugs and a sound machine to mitigate this!

Also, please note we have fast WiFi access, but no TVs. You are welcome to bring streaming devices if you need this kind of entertainment!
